生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven empowered-state reference
for Riven throughout the video.

Keep the same woman,
appearance,
hair,
clothing,
armor,
injuries,
and exhausted physical condition.

Riven already holds
the fully activated emerald-green empowered weapon.

Use the provided empowered weapon reference.

Keep the same weapon design:
dark physical metal at the core,
bright emerald runes,
and translucent emerald-green energy
forming the larger blade silhouette.

Keep the empowered weapon active
throughout the entire video.


Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
for the opponent.

Keep the same mysterious humanoid dark figure.

Its body remains an unstable dark silhouette
blending naturally with smoke.

It is already badly weakened and damaged.


Use the provided battlefield image
for the environment.

Keep the same broad village road,
burning wooden buildings,
dense smoke,
orange firelight,
ash,
embers,
and distant mountain atmosphere.


=== STARTING STATE ===

The battle has already been going on.

Both fighters are exhausted.

Riven stands on the burning road,
breathing heavily.

Her emerald empowered weapon
is still fully active.

Far ahead,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
is badly weakened.

Its unstable silhouette flickers
and black smoke continuously escapes
from its damaged form.

There is clear distance
between them.

Neither attacks immediately.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Simple and visually readable action.

This is the finishing sequence,
not another extended fight.

Do not add additional combat sequences.

Do not add shadow copies.

Do not add extra attacks.

Focus on one final confrontation
and one decisive finishing attack.

Natural physical movement.

Strong cinematic impact.

Emerald-green wind and runic energy
belong to Riven.

Black smoke-like darkness
belongs to the Mysterious Dark Figure.

Natural fire,
wind,
heavy breathing,
crackling wood,
energy sound,
and environmental sound.

No subtitles.

No background music.

One dialogue line only.


=== VIDEO ===

Begin with a close cinematic view
of Riven.

She is exhausted.

Her breathing is heavy.

Small cuts,
ash,
and dirt remain on her face.

The emerald weapon glows
beside her.


Riven slowly raises her eyes
toward the dark figure.


Cut to the Mysterious Dark Figure
standing farther down
the burning road.

Its damaged silhouette
struggles to remain stable.

Black smoke leaks
from its body.


A brief silence.


Riven looks directly at it.


Without shouting,

with quiet controlled anger,

Riven says:


"You took enough from me."


Hold a brief silence
after the dialogue.


The dark figure becomes still.


Then the surrounding smoke
begins moving unnaturally.


Black smoke
from across the burning road
is violently pulled
toward the figure.


Darkness gathers rapidly
around its body.


Its humanoid silhouette
remains visible
inside the growing darkness.


Do not transform it
into a monster.


The figure gathers
everything it has left
into one final attack.


Cut back to Riven.


She sees the darkness building.


She does not run.


She plants her feet
and grips the empowered weapon
with both hands.


The emerald runes
become brighter.


Green energy intensifies
around the blade.


Wind begins gathering
around Riven.


Ash and glowing embers
lift from the road.


Her hair and clothing
move violently in the wind.


Emerald-green wind energy
spirals around the blade.


Riven prepares
one final strike.


Across the road,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
suddenly launches forward.


It rushes directly toward Riven
inside a massive wave
of black smoke-like darkness.


The dark wave
surges down the road
toward her.


Riven holds her ground.


She waits.


The darkness
rapidly closes the distance.


At the final moment—


Riven steps forward.


She turns her whole body
into one powerful sword swing.


WIND SLASH.


The empowered blade releases
one massive crescent-shaped wave
of emerald-green wind
and runic energy.


The emerald Wind Slash
flies directly forward.


It collides
with the incoming darkness.


BLACK DARKNESS
against
EMERALD WIND.


Hold the collision
for one brief powerful moment.


Then—


the emerald Wind Slash
cuts through the center
of the dark wave.


The darkness splits apart.


The green energy
continues forward


and passes directly
through the Mysterious Dark Figure.


Sudden silence.


The figure stops moving.


Its dark silhouette
remains standing
for a brief moment.


Thin emerald cracks
appear through
the unstable dark form.


Then the silhouette
begins losing its shape.


Black smoke separates
from its body.


The remaining wind
pulls the darkness apart.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
dissolves completely
into black smoke
and dark particles.


No explosion.

No physical corpse.

No transformation.


The figure disappears completely.


The supernatural darkness
disappears with it.


Only the normal smoke
and fire of the burning settlement remain.


Riven remains standing
on the road.


She is completely exhausted.


Her empowered emerald weapon
is still active.


She looks toward
the empty place
where the figure disappeared.


Nothing returns.


Hold briefly.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure
has been completely destroyed.

No silhouette remains.

No supernatural darkness remains.

The battle is completely over.

Riven remains standing,
exhausted and injured.

Her emerald empowered weapon
is still active.

Do not make the green energy fade yet.

Do not introduce civilians.

Do not introduce another enemy.

Do not begin another fight.

End with Riven alone
on the burning road
after the final victory.

CUT.、16:9
